caption: The drawing depicts a lidded bowl with a matching saucer beneath it, centered on a plain, light beige background. The bowl is predominantly blue with vertical ribbed segments, and it features ornate white decorations that resemble draped garlands or festoons around the upper rim. The lid is also blue, topped with a white knob resembling a small cluster or ornate leaflet, and it matches the bowl’s decorative motif with similar white draped elements. The saucer beneath the bowl is blue with a white border, echoing the color scheme of the bowl and lid. There is a faint signature or text in the lower right section of the image. The overall composition places the bowl and saucer slightly off-center, with all objects oriented to show the decorations and contours clearly.
title: Sugar Bowl
